principle: The AUTHORIZATION layer over the registries: registries say what EXISTS, the credential plane says what's REACHABLE, this says WHO MAY USE IT. Not every tool/key/capability is open to every user. DENY-BY-DEFAULT for sensitive resources (least privilege). A principal may ALWAYS use a credential service they brought their OWN key for (it's theirs) — but a BYO key does NOT grant restricted tools. Platform keys + expensive services are plan-gated (cost/abuse); evasion/social/PII tools need an explicit GRANT; private-bench/internal registries are staff-only. Per-product realms (no SSO) — entitlements are per tenant/product. serves_truth=false.

tiers.requires: a paid plan OR the principal's OWN key for the service (BYO)
an explicit GRANT (evasion / social_scrape / pii) + signed-in
staff / internal plan only (private-bench, the brain, dev tooling)

rule_precedence: credential key_ownership byo (owner-only key) -> plan_gated (BYO satisfies it)
keyless deterministic tool / open registry -> public
byo_rule: a principal may always use a credential service in their byo_keys (their own account/plan); this satisfies a plan_gated KEY gate but never a restricted TOOL grant
